synonyms.title: synonyms
synonyms.text: idle loaf lounge loll laze mean to spend time doing nothing. idle may be used in reference to persons that move lazily or without purpose. loaf suggests either resting or wandering about as though there were nothing to do. lounge, though occasionally used as equal to idle or loaf, typically conveys an additional implication of resting or reclining against a support or of physical comfort and ease in relaxation. loll also carries an implication of a posture similar to that of lounge, but places greater stress upon an indolent or relaxed attitude. laze usually implies the relaxation of a busy person enjoying a vacation or moments of leisure.
examples: she does her work and then loafs the rest of the day
